_about: Public-domain B. B. Warfield (1851-1921, Princeton Theological Seminary) for the Word Hoard: books published in his lifetime (1886-1921), raw Internet Archive OCR from library scans. The ten-volume Oxford Works (1927-1932) is left off: published after his death, partly in 1929 or later, and mostly reprints of review articles; the rights gate refuses those years anyway. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of his books. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 5 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted. Extended 2026-10-28 by lane A at Adam's request (his Logos author list): his smaller books and pamphlets of 1880 to 1921 (The Gospel of the Incarnation, The Printing of the Westminster Confession, Calvin's Doctrine of God, Oberlin Perfectionism and others), and the first four volumes of the Oxford Works: Revelation and Inspiration (1927), Biblical Doctrines and Christology and Criticism (1929), and Studies in Tertullian and Augustine (1930). Works published in 1930 or earlier are public domain in the US as of 2026, so the earlier note that the rights gate refuses these years no longer holds for these four; the 1931 and 1932 volumes (Calvin and Calvinism, The Westminster Assembly, Perfectionism, Studies in Theology, Critical Reviews) stay off until they enter the public domain.
